decisive_items: Shows a morning glory optic disc anomaly with low-lying detachment of the peripapillary retina
response.rationale: R3 directly matches the key diagnostic finding of morning glory optic disc anomaly and also covers the associated retinal detachment. R1 only covers the retinal detachment, missing the disc anomaly. R2 only covers crystals, which are secondary and not specific. C1 is a redundant completion of R1.

rejected.why: Only supports crystals, not the disc anomaly or detachment.
Redundant completion of R1 with no new evidence.
